manifest.prompt: A continuous detailed hand-drawn anime performance shot. Preserve the pictured singer, his light facial hair, clothing, rings, microphone grip and stage geometry. His frightened concern becomes one urgent, restrained plea in time with the supplied song. His lips and jaw articulate the actual sung phrase, including natural closures and breath, while his face remains recognizable. His free forearm extends once from near his abdomen into a small supported open-palm plea, without lifting over his face. Shoulder, elbow, wrist and five fingers stay coherent. His other hand holds the microphone securely beside his mouth. He stays grounded and distressed, then settles without reassurance. Locked camera and stable drawn lighting.
